title: High-capacity transcranial direct current stimulation (HC-tDCS)
title_zh: 高容量经颅直流电刺激（HC-tDCS）
abstract: BACKGROUND: Enhancing tDCS technology can support the delivery of higher current intensities, enabling broader dose-response studies in human clinical trials. METHODS: High-Capacity tDCS (HC-tDCS) integrates novel electrodes and adaptive current/voltage controlled electronics. Multi-layer HC electrodes include polarity-specific redox layers and engineered hydrogel interfaces, configured for a bifrontotemporal montage. The stimulator design includes adaptive ramps with hybrid voltage-current control and low compliance voltage. Scanning electron microscopy (SEM) and electrical impedance spectroscopy (EIS) characterized electrode properties. Tolerability of HC-tDCS was tested at target currents of 1-6 mA (in 1 mA increments) for 30 min on 10 healthy subjects, and compared with conventional tDCS using 2 mA F3-F4 sponge-electrodes. Tolerability was assessed according to the 100 mm visual analogue scale for pain (VAS-P100), skin erythema assessment, thermal imaging, and adverse event questionnaires. MRI-derived computational models predicted brain electric fields. RESULTS: The electrode design incorporating roughened redox layers with polarity-specific electrochemical capacity supports high-charge direct current stimulation. In all subjects, HC-tDCS was well tolerated at all tested doses (1-6 mA) with minor transient adverse events. Mean VAS-P100 (±SD) was 17.17 ± 11.12 for 6 mA HC-tDCS and 18.30 ± 9.49 for 2 mA sponge-electrode tDCS. HC-tDCS operated at lower voltage than sponge-tDCS. Across MRI-derived head models, 6 mA HC-tDCS produced 2.25-3.26 V/m electric fields, ∼4x higher than conventional 2 mA tDCS electric fields of 0.49-0.85 V/m. 6 mA HC-tDCS electric fields can exceed 1 V/m across frontal cortical and deeper limbic regions, including the dorsolateral prefrontal cortex, anterior cingulate cortex, insula, and amygdala. CONCLUSIONS: HC-tDCS was well tolerated by participants and expands the accessible tDCS dose range, enabling stimulation up to at least 6 mA and substantially higher electric fields throughout cortical and deeper brain regions than conventional 2 mA tDCS.
abstract_zh: 背景：提升tDCS技术可支持更高电流强度的传递，从而在人体临床试验中开展更广泛的剂量-反应研究。方法：高容量tDCS（HC-tDCS）集成了新型电极和自适应电流/电压控制电子设备。多层HC电极包含极性特定的氧化还原层和工程化水凝胶界面，配置为双前颞电极阵列。刺激器设计包括自适应上升斜率的混合电压-电流控制和低顺从电压。扫描电子显微镜（SEM）和电阻抗光谱（EIS）用于表征电极性能。HC-tDCS的耐受性在10名健康受试者中以1-6 mA（每1 mA递增）为目标电流，持续30 min进行测试，并与使用2 mA F3–F4海绵电极的传统tDCS进行比较。耐受性评估依据100 mm视觉模拟量表（VAS-P100）疼痛评分、皮肤红斑评估、热成像和不良事件问卷。基于MRI的计算模型预测脑电场。结果：采用粗糙氧化还原层并具极性特定电化学容量的电极设计支持高电荷直流刺激。在所有受试者中，HC-tDCS在所有测试剂量（1-6 mA）下均良好耐受，出现轻微短暂的不良事件。平均VAS-P100（±SD）为6 mA HC-tDCS 17.17 ± 11.12，2 mA海绵电极tDCS 18.30 ± 9.49。HC-tDCS的工作电压低于海绵电极tDCS。在基于MRI的头部模型中，6 mA HC-tDCS产生的电场为2.25-3.26 V/m，约为传统2 mA tDCS电场0.49-0.85 V/m的四倍。6 mA HC-tDCS的电场可在额叶皮层及更深层边缘系统（包括背外侧前额叶皮层、前扣带皮层、岛叶和杏仁核）超过1 V/m。结论：HC-tDCS被受试者良好耐受，扩展了可用tDCS剂量范围，使刺激可达至少6 mA，并在皮层及更深脑区产生显著高于传统2 mA tDCS的电场。
